In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, UEO can be a good fuel and a good promoter to radiation, provided that it is preheated, the LPG flow rate is high, the liquid fuel/LPGR is low, and the furnace temperature is high.
, UEO can be used as a fuel and/or a promoter to radiation in furnaces, but only when the mass ratio of liquid fuel/LPG is in a specific range, and when the mass flow rate is in a specific low range.
UEO is a good fuel and a good promoter to radiation in the range of 0.5 to 1.5 of the mass ratio of UEO/LPG, and a mass flow rate of LPG between 0.2 and 0.4 kg/min.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the UEO is an excellent fuel and promoter of radiation.

, UEO, in addition to being a good promoter to radiation, is a fuel that can be used in furnaces, with the same efficiency and emission levels as those of diesel and UCkO.
